title: Problem Management Plus (Group PM+)
author: Owoicho Ajayi (Founder & Lead Director)
excerpt: Over five engaging sessions, Shape Your Mind Consult concluded an intensive Group Problem Management Plus (Group PM+) training to equip humanitarian facilitators with evidence-based psychosocial skills.
content:
Over the past five days, Shape Your Mind Consult successfully concluded a high-impact five-day Group Problem Management Plus (Group PM+) training workshop.

Over five engaging sessions, participants strengthened their understanding of the World Health Organization Group PM+ model, facilitation skills, and strategies for supporting individuals and families affected by adversity and severe stress.

Core Competencies Delivered

  • Managing Stress & Somatic Calming: Training facilitators on slow breathing exercises to stabilize autonomic arousal.
  • Problem-Solving Techniques: Guiding participants to break overwhelming practical problems into manageable, actionable steps.
  • Behavioral Activation: Re-engaging with positive and restorative daily routines even in high-stress humanitarian settings.
  • Strengthening Social Support: Building peer-led psychosocial networks within communities.

Through practical exercises, structured role plays, and peer learning, participants built the confidence to deliver quality, context-adapted psychosocial interventions within vulnerable communities. Grateful to all participants for their commitment, active engagement, and passion for expanding access to quality and scalable mental health care.

title: Strengthening Frontline Humanitarian Response Through PM+ Training of Trainers in Maiduguri
author: Owoicho Ajayi (Founder & Lead Director)
excerpt: Shape Your Mind facilitated a transformative five-day PM+ Training of Trainers in Maiduguri, empowering Doctors, Nurses, Psychologists, and CHEWs serving conflict-affected populations.
content:
In the month of March, Shape Your Mind Consult facilitated a transformative five-day PM+ (Problem Management Plus) Training of Trainers (ToT) in Maiduguri, Borno State.

This intensive clinical refresher brought together Doctors, Nurses, Clinical Psychologists, case managers, HR leads, project directors, and Community Health Extension Workers (CHEWs) serving on the frontlines of humanitarian response in Northeast Nigeria.

Clinical Rigor & Scalable Impact

The five-day session focused on sharpening clinical precision, building facilitation confidence, updating intervention protocols, and fostering cross-organizational knowledge exchange. Participants were guided through case conceptualization, managing complex trauma, and safeguarding ethical standards.

Sustainable Community Capacity

By strengthening the pedagogical and technical skills of these master trainers, Shape Your Mind has directly enhanced psychosocial service delivery across conflict-affected communities. This refresher training empowered participants to mentor frontline lay workers, ensuring that life-saving psychosocial support remains sustainable, ethical, and deeply rooted in empathy.

title: Optimizing Performance: A Holistic Approach to Success in the Workplace
author: Owoicho Ajayi (Clinical Director)
excerpt: Achieving peak workplace performance requires more than meeting deadlines—it demands a sustainable balance across mental clarity, physical stamina, and corporate psychological safety.
content:
Achieving peak performance in the modern workplace involves far more than merely meeting project deadlines and delivering quarterly targets. It demands a holistic, sustainable approach that balances mental resilience, physical health, and emotional well-being.

Understanding the Dynamics of Workplace Performance

Workplace performance is influenced by complex interconnected factors, including the physical environment, organizational leadership culture, emotional job demands, and individual coping strategies. When employees feel supported, psychologically safe, and valued, they consistently innovate and perform at their peak.

Key Strategies for Enhancing Workplace Performance

  1. Cultivate Psychological Safety: Foster an organizational culture where team members can voice concerns, ask questions, and share creative ideas without fear of retribution.
  2. Prioritize Preventive Employee Wellness: Deploy tailored Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs) with Shape Your Mind Consult to address burnout before it causes absenteeism.
  3. Continuous Capacity Building: Deliver regular mental fitness webinars, stress-management workshops, and leadership de-escalation training.
  4. Enforce Work-Life Boundaries: Protect cognitive recovery by establishing boundaries around after-hours communication and encouraging deliberate rest cycles.

title: Social Behavioural Workshop: Empowering Community Caregivers
author: Thlama Mperiju & Owoicho Ajayi
excerpt: Shape Your Mind Consult Ltd facilitated an experiential workshop for Supertouch Kindness Foundation (SKF), equipping frontline caregivers with behavioral modification tools.
content:
On the 29th to 31st of July 2024, Shape Your Mind Consult Ltd facilitated an immersive 3-day workshop in partnership with Supertouch Kindness Foundation (SKF).

The workshop gathered dedicated humanitarian workers, volunteers, and community caregivers for an intensive training in social behavioral modification, empathetic listening, and psychological first aid.

Mental Health Can and Must Be Discussed

A core pillar of the engagement focused on dismantling social taboos. Participants examined how community stigma prevents vulnerable individuals from seeking timely clinical help. Through guided role-play scenarios, caregivers learned how to hold space for emotional distress, validate personal struggles, and refer individuals safely to specialized clinical care.

Care for the Caregiver

Secondary trauma and compassion fatigue represent silent threats to community workers. Our specialists equipped participants with personal grounding exercises, peer check-in frameworks, and self-compassion toolkits to protect their own psychological endurance.

title: Mental Health Awareness Month: Breaking the Silence
author: Ene Margaret (Psychiatric Nurse)
excerpt: Mental health is an integral cornerstone of our overall existence. Shape Your Mind Consult joined global advocacy to dismantle stigma and encourage early therapeutic help.
content:
At Shape Your Mind Consult, we recognize that mental health is an indispensable cornerstone of overall human vitality. In commemoration of Mental Health Awareness Month, we joined global advocates in urging individuals, families, and corporations to prioritize emotional well-being.

Why Mental Health Matters Everyday

Mental health governs how we process cognition, regulate emotions, withstand physical stress, make sound decisions, and cultivate relationships. When mental equilibrium is compromised, every facet of life—from career trajectory to marital harmony—suffers consequences.

Breaking Generational Stigma

Awareness is the first step toward breaking the silence. For far too long, individuals struggling with anxiety, depression, and trauma have suffered behind closed doors due to fear of judgment. Seeking professional psychotherapeutic care is an act of profound self-respect, wisdom, and inner courage.

title: Navigating Stress in the Academic Journey: A Guide to Mental Wellness
author: Samuel Ogwuche (Occupational Therapist)
excerpt: Embarking on an academic journey offers profound intellectual growth but often triggers overwhelming cognitive stress. Discover clinical strategies to maintain balance.
content:
Embarking on an academic journey can be an exhilarating milestone filled with intellectual growth, career prospects, and personal transformation. However, demanding curricula, continuous examinations, financial pressures, and social adjustments frequently induce intense psychological strain.

Signs of Chronic Academic Burnout

  • Persistent mental fog and inability to concentrate during lectures or study sessions.
  • Disrupted circadian sleep cycles and chronic morning exhaustion.
  • Imposter syndrome: Feeling unworthy of academic achievements or terrified of perceived failure.
  • Social isolation and neglecting physical nourishment or recreation.

Practical Wellness Recommendations

Prioritizing mental wellness is essential for authentic academic success. Implement targeted revision intervals (the Pomodoro technique), maintain consistent sleep hygiene, engage in physical movement to dissipate cortisol, and seek confidential guidance from our counselors whenever academic anxiety impairs daily functioning.

title: Optimizing Performance: Foundations of Work-Life Equilibrium
author: Owoicho Ajayi (Founder & Lead Director)
excerpt: A foundational examination of the neurological interplay between workplace pressure and human capacity, highlighting practical strategies for sustainable corporate productivity.
content:
True professional excellence cannot be decoupled from emotional and psychological equilibrium. In today's hyper-connected enterprise landscape, the boundary between professional demands and restorative personal time has become increasingly blurred.

The Cognitive Cost of Hyper-Connectivity

When employees remain continuously tethered to emails, messaging applications, and project boards, the nervous system remains locked in sympathetic arousal. Over time, cognitive bandwidth narrows, emotional reactivity increases, and creative problem-solving diminishes.

Institutionalizing Sustainable Habits

Organizations must partner with mental health professionals to institute wellness audits, clear digital boundary protocols, and accessible counseling retainers. When enterprises protect employee mental bandwidth, staff retention increases and institutional performance reaches its highest potential.

title: Nurturing Mental Well-being: A Vital Aspect of a Successful Life
author: Shape Your Mind Clinical Team
excerpt: In a fast-paced world measuring success purely by material output, psychological balance remains the true foundation upon which all lasting achievements are sustained.
content:
In the fast-paced modern world where success is often measured predominantly by professional accolades, financial metrics, and social stature, mental well-being is frequently sidelined. Yet psychological balance is the bedrock upon which all enduring success is constructed.

The Connection Between Mental Health & Sustainable Success

Without emotional stability, external triumphs feel hollow and unsustainable. Chronic internal turmoil clouds decision-making, strains personal bonds, and eventually triggers physical health collapses. Nurturing mental well-being is an active, daily practice of self-attunement and intentional living.

Five Clinical Habits for Daily Resilience

  1. Mindful Self-Reflection: Dedicate 10 minutes daily to journaling or silent introspection to process unresolved thoughts.
  2. Nourish Meaningful Connections: Cultivate deep relationships where you can share authentic emotions without fear of judgment.
  3. Somatic Movement: Engage in regular moderate physical exercise to stimulate endorphins and dissipate physical tension.
  4. Boundaries as Self-Care: Learn to say 'no' without guilt to demands that over-extend your psychological resources.
  5. Routine Clinical Check-Ins: Engage professional therapists at Shape Your Mind Consult for routine emotional maintenance.
